review_evidence: README describes LeanLangur as talk/demo material and a partly self-contained programming-focused introduction to Lean.
The 44 current-primary modules cover data structures and algorithms such as binary search trees, sorting, stacks, arithmetic programs, equality, combinatorics and language/interpreter examples.
Demo/example-style files remain useful formal/programming examples; no exact build-only Lean file or demonstrably redundant generated subtree was identified in this unit.
summary: Retain LeanLangur’s programming-focused Lean instructional developments and examples in full.
